item.title: City of LaGrange Animal Shelter launches enhanced webpage with AI-powered lost pet reporting tool
item.description: LaGrange Animal Shelter unveils enhanced webpage with AI-powered lost pet tool, letting residents report missing pets online, upload photos and reach 3,200+ partner shelters.

item.title: LaGrange Mayor Arrington, with Wellstar West Georgia Medical Center, announces Spring Mayor’s Health Initiative
item.description: LaGrange Mayor Jim Arrington and Wellstar West Georgia Medical Center launch the Spring Mayor’s Health Initiative, offering free fitness events for all ages February through May.

item.title: LaGrange considering golf cart ordinance update
item.description: LaGrange weighs golf cart rule changes to allow downtown shuttles for visitors and residents with mobility issues; police to review safety, no vote yet.

item.title: Council discusses Sweetland’s year and changes coming in 2026
item.description: Council reviews Sweetland Amphitheatre’s finances, popular ice rink and street parties, and outlines 2026 shifts in ticket pricing, paid parking and security screening.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - John Tures: Oppose Those Who Portray Politicians Or Other People As Animals
item.description: Portraying politicians as animals revives racist, pre-Civil War animosity. John Tures urges Americans to condemn such depictions of Obama, Trump and others across party lines.

item.title: TOTY Rivers fosters family culture in classroom
item.description: Berta Weathersbee Elementary second-grade teacher Deondra Rivers, known for her family-style classroom and creative projects, is named Teacher of the Year by her peers.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S View - L. Michelle Moore: Picking Up Pecans
item.description: Picking up overlooked pecans along local sidewalks leads L. Michelle Moore to a bigger point: solar energy, like nuts on the ground, is abundant but underused in tackling energy and affordability challenges.

item.title: BEST OF THE BEST: Teacher of the Year finalists recognized
item.description: Four Troup County educators have been named Teacher of the Year finalists for the overall systemwide award.
